raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fix a crash when attaching a LoRA adapter at runtime to a FLUX.2 (multimodal_gen) model loaded from an FP8-quantized checkpoint (ModelOpt FP8).

## Motivation

`Flux2ParallelSelfAttention.__init__` decides the fused fast-path flags
`_enable_fp8_token_cat` / `_enable_nvfp4_token_cat` by inspecting
`self.to_out.quant_method` on the raw quantized `RowParallelLinear`. When a
LoRA adapter is attached, the LoRA pipeline replaces those quantized linears
with wrapper modules that do not expose `quant_method` / `input_scale`. The
init-time flags then go stale, and `forward()` reads those attributes off the
wrapper, crashing instead of falling back to the unfused path.

Reproduced on an L20 GPU (SM89) with the official FLUX.2-klein-9b-fp8
checkpoint and a runtime-attached LoRA adapter (locally trained, cannot be
shared): the model crashes on the first forward pass after the adapter is
mounted.

Related: #35970 (diffusion LoRA + FP8 crash on static merge) — the merge-policy
half is handled by the `can_merge_base_weight` dynamic fallback; this PR fixes
the stale fast-path flags on the dynamic path.

## Modifications

  attributes, the fusion is simply disabled.
- Add `Flux2Transformer2DModel.revalidate_fp8_fast_paths()` which also re-runs
  `configure_fp8_norm_quant()` per block.
- Call the hook from `LoRAPipeline` after the wrappers are installed (for
  modules that expose it, e.g. `transformer` / `transformer_2`).

No behavior change when no LoRA is attached — the revalidation hook only runs
after LoRA wrappers are installed.

## Accuracy Tests

End-to-end A/B on a single L20 GPU (SM89) with the official
FLUX.2-klein-9b-fp8 checkpoint and a runtime-attached LoRA adapter (locally
trained, cannot be shared), built on this PR branch (latest main):

- Without the patch: non-LoRA generation succeeds; after `POST /v1/set_lora`
  (merge_mode=dynamic), the first LoRA generation fails immediately with
  `AttributeError: 'ColumnParallelLinearWithLoRA' object has no attribute
  'input_scale'` inside `Flux2Transformer2DModel.forward`.
- With the patch: the same request completes normally and produces valid
  1024x1024 output; no errors in the server log.
- Non-LoRA inference is untouched: same prompt/seed before and after the
  patch yields bit-identical output images.
- ruff / ruff-format / isort pass per pre-commit rules.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A — this change only disables fused fast paths that would otherwise crash
under LoRA; it does not affect the non-LoRA serving path.

detail.title: [Fix] diffusion/lora: revalidate FLUX.2 FP8/NVFP4 fast paths after LoRA attach

files.patch:
@@ -962,6 +962,28 @@ def __init__(
             supported_attention_backends=supported_attention_backends,
         )
 
+    def revalidate_fp8_fast_paths(self) -> None:
+        """Recompute fused FP8/NVFP4 fast-path eligibility after submodule changes.
+
+        LoRA wrapping replaces quantized linears with wrappers that do not
+        expose ``quant_method``/``input_scale``; flags decided at ``__init__``
+        against the raw modules then go stale and ``forward`` would read those
+        attributes off the wrapper and crash. Read them defensively here so a
+        recheck after wrapping disables the fusion instead.
+        """
+        self._enable_fp8_token_cat = self.tp_size == 1 and isinstance(
+            getattr(self.to_out, "quant_method", None), ModelOptFp8LinearMethod
+        )
+        capability = current_platform.get_device_capability()
+        self._enable_nvfp4_token_cat = (
+            self.tp_size == 1
+            and capability is not None
+            and (capability.major, capability.minor) == (10, 3)
+            and isinstance(
+                getattr(self.to_out, "quant_method", None), ModelOptFp4LinearMethod
+            )
+        )
+
     def _patch_to_out_weight_loader(self) -> None:
         inner_dim, mlp_dim = self.inner_dim, self.mlp_hidden_dim
         tp_size, tp_rank = self.tp_size, self.to_out.tp_rank
@@ -1553,6 +1575,18 @@ def post_load_weights(self) -> None:
                 total,
             )
 
+    def revalidate_fp8_fast_paths(self) -> None:
+        """Recheck FP8 fast paths after LoRA (or other) submodule replacement.
+
+        ``configure_fp8_norm_quant`` is getattr-safe, so a wrapper that hides
+        the quant attributes simply turns each flag off.
+        """
+        for block in self.transformer_blocks:
+            block.configure_fp8_norm_quant()
+        for block in self.single_transformer_blocks:
+            block.configure_fp8_norm_quant()
+            block.attn.revalidate_fp8_fast_paths()
+
     def __init__(
         self,
         config: FluxConfig,

@@ -563,6 +563,15 @@ def convert_to_lora_layers(self, snapshot_base: bool = True) -> None:
                 converted_count_critic,
             )
 
+        # The wrappers replaced quantized linears; FP8 fused fast paths decided
+        # against the raw modules are stale and would read quant attributes
+        # (input_scale/quant_method) off the wrappers. Let each DiT recheck.
+        for module_name in ("transformer", "transformer_2"):
+            module = self.modules.get(module_name)
+            revalidate = getattr(module, "revalidate_fp8_fast_paths", None)
+            if callable(revalidate):
+                revalidate()
+
     def _normalize_lora_params(
         self,
         lora_nickname: str | list[str],
